title: Boss: triage the incident log
summary: An outage at 09:12. Pull the right lines out of the log, safely, before the incident call starts.

steps.title: The incident
body: It is 09:20. Checkout has been failing since 09:12 and the incident call starts in ten minutes. You have the
service log and a list of hosts from the load balancer. Your job:
1. Spot the order ids in the error lines.
2. Count the real `[ERROR]` lines (a teammate's filter counted far too many).
3. Report which of the load balancer's hosts appear in the log.
4. Fix the version filter that is matching the wrong builds.
Literal text, escaping and classes are all you need.

steps.title: Order ids
prompt: Order ids are `ORD-` followed by exactly six ASCII digits: `ORD-004211`. Match the whole string when it is a valid
order id. (Repeating a class six times is fine here; the next module shortens it.)

steps.title: Count the real errors
prompt: Write `int CountErrors(string[] lines)`: how many lines contain the literal tag `[ERROR]` (capitals, brackets
included). Lines with `ERROR` but no brackets, or other tags, do not count. Use a `Regex`.
template: "09:12:06 [error] lower case is a different logger",
Dojo.Eq("none in an empty log", 0, CountErrors(new string[0]));

steps.title: Which hosts appear in the log?
prompt: Write `List<string> HostsInLog(string log, string[] hosts)`. Return, in the order of `hosts`, every host that
appears in `log` exactly as written, ignoring case. Hosts contain dots, and one of them has a port in brackets.
Give every regex a match timeout of 250 ms: the hosts come from another system's config.
solution: var regex = new Regex(Regex.Escape(host), RegexOptions.IgnoreCase, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250));
template: var dojoLog = "09:12 upstream API-1.CONTOSO.COM refused\n09:13 retry on api-2.contoso.com [8443] ok\n09:14 apix3.contoso.com";
Dojo.Eq("two hosts found, in list order", new List<string> { "api-1.contoso.com", "api-2.contoso.com [8443]" }, HostsInLog(dojoLog, dojoHosts));
Dojo.Eq("no hosts, no results", new List<string>(), HostsInLog(dojoLog, new string[0]));

steps.title: Fix the build filter
prompt: **Symptom.** The deploy script picks builds with the pattern `3.5.[0-9]`. Last night it deployed build `385.1`
instead of `3.5.1`, and it also picks `3x5y7`.
Fix it so it finds a version `3.5.` followed by one digit, and nothing else.
